objective: Suppress repeated normal PTT transmission notices in Notifications and badges while preserving SOS, Priority, ordinary social notifications, in-app PTT duty status, and closed-app PTT push/audio receive.
productionBaselineEvidence: Main source 922d26d9 verified before branch; deployed OTA and physical Android PTT behavior not independently verified. This branch is DEV only, not released; production DB unchanged.
chosenApproach: Client-side display/count filtering only for kind ptt_incoming in the native/web Notification Center and foreground handlers. Retain all transport rows and incoming visible/headless pushes for background reliability.
selectionRationale: Changing the production floor-claim RPC or removing PTT transport pushes risks breaking background receive. Existing backend uses one notification per transmission to dispatch the headless and visible push signals.
alternativeApproaches: Deleting per-transmission notification rows or push fanout: rejected because closed-app PTT receivers depend on it.
Mutating production database history to mark old records read: rejected because no user records need changing.
acceptanceChecks: Normal PTT transmission is not added to Notifications UI or native/web unread counters.
Normal PTT push stays a receive signal but does not create foreground visual/sound/badge spam.
PTT SOS, Priority, community emergency, ordinary messages remain visible and audible as before.
Normal PTT remains receivable in the background via existing dual visible/headless pipeline; Android physical-device validation remains a release requirement.
Existing PTT hold/release, floor authorization, native foreground duty, Stream audio, database notification dispatch, all data and RLS unchanged.
Static and handler behavior tests pass; production remains unchanged until verified release candidate.
